title: Module review
subtitle: Everything from North America
objectives: Link each region to its grapes

steps.prompt: Match each region to its signature grape.
steps.explanation: Each region has found its grape in under a century.

steps.prompt: Washington State vineyards rely on irrigation.
steps.explanation: Yes. East of the Cascades, rainfall is too low for vines without it.

steps.prompt: Which help cool California's coastal vineyards?
steps.explanation: California summers are dry. Fog, ocean currents and valley orientation do the cooling.

steps.prompt: Prohibition in the United States lasted from 1920 to ____.
steps.explanation: 1933. Fine wine only really grew again from the 1960s.

steps.title: What you learned
points: AVAs define place; labels need 85% from the area
California's fog and valleys shape its styles
Oregon is Pinot Noir country; Washington an irrigated desert
Canada is the world's leader in ice wine
